title: Map the Maybe
goal: Double the first element if there is one. Use Option methods, not unwrap.
hints: xs[0] on an empty slice doesn't return None - it panics. first() is the honest accessor.
map transforms the inside of a Some and passes None through untouched. No unwrapping required.
explanation: Indexing promises an element and panics when the slice is empty - both the direct index and the unwrap variant compile, then die on the empty-slice test. first() returns Option<&i32>, and map() is the combinator that works INSIDE it: transform the Some, ferry the None. This is the everyday Option idiom - reach for combinators before reaching for unwrap, and let the type carry the emptiness to the caller.
